title: Generator calculation for the strict finite pullback comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme map $f:X\to Y$, a complex $P$ of completed-coefficient module sheaves, a complex $C$ of strict quotient systems, and isomorphisms $\kappa_n:C_n\simeq P\otimes A_{E,n+1}$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Let $q$ be an isomorphism from the restricted inverse-image tower of $C$ to the defining finite-pullback tower of $P$, whose values on inverse-image unit generators are the finite inverse-image unit applied to $\kappa_n$ of the corresponding section. Let $e_n$ be the ordinary chain comparison obtained by restricted evaluation, finiteSystemPullbackEvaluation [lem-pod-finite-system-pullback-coherence], and the inverse of integralFinitePullbackModel [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Then $q_n=\operatorname{Res}(f_n^*\kappa_n)\circ e_n$, with composition read in Lean diagrammatic order: first $e_n$, then restricted finite inverse image of $\kappa_n$.

source.place: Tag 03D3, inverse-image adjunction; proetale.tex Tags 099N(5) and 0941; generator step of the strict finite component calculation.

proof.text: Compose the ordinary restricted-evaluation, finite-evaluation, and finite-presentation comparisons. Their defining unit equations show that the resulting isomorphism e sends each restricted system inverse-image unit section to the finite inverse-image unit section.

Precompose q_n by the inverse of e_n. Local surjectivity of the completed coefficient projection makes the restricted Hom map injective and permits finite-linear adjunction Hom extensionality. The given generator equation and naturality of the finite pullback unit identify the resulting map with restricted pullback of kappa_n in every degree. Homological-complex extensionality and cancellation of e_n give the asserted equality.

theorem strictComponent_generators {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P)
    (q : (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj C)).asFunctor ≅
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).obj P)
    (hq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : Y.ProEt)
        (x : (C.X i).val.obj (op (n, U))),
      ((q.hom.app (op n)).f i).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
        (integralComparisonRestrictedSection l E X
          ((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).obj (C.X i)) n
          (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
          (integralComparisonSequenceGenerator l E f (C.X i) n U x)) =
        integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E f n
          (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P).X i) U
          (((κ n).hom.f i).val.app (op U)
            (coefficientEvaluationSection l E Y (C.X i) n (op U) x))) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := strictLevel_zero l E f n
    let R := scalarReductionRestriction l E X n
    let e := (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (strictLevel l E f n) (.up ℤ)).app C
    q.hom.app (op n) = e.hom ≫
      (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (((integralOperationsLevelPullback l E f n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          (κ n).hom)
